uge-165955.summary: WS2812B Programmable RGB LED Chip 3535 SMD Package

blocks.text: WS2812B Programmable RGB LED Chip 3535 SMD Package
Supply voltage (VDD): ≈ 5.0 V (typical operating range shown in datasheets around 4.5–5.5 V).

Logic / protocol: Single-wire, NZR serial protocol at ~800 kHz timing (one 24-bit word per pixel: G,R,B). Timing examples: T0H ≈ 0.4 µs, T1H ≈ 0.8 µs, reset (Treset) > 50 µs. 8-bit PWM per color (256 levels).

Typical current (per LED at full white): up to ~60 mA (≈20 mA per color channel) for classic WS2812B (5050). Many 3535 / “mini” variants use internal current-limiting and can show lower per-color currents (datasheet variants list values like ~12 mA per LED per color for some 3535 versions) — check the specific vendor datasheet for the exact number. Use 60 mA as a conservative design figure for full-white brightness unless your vendor datasheet states lower.
Luminous output / LEDs: depends on manufacturer / bin. Typical mini 3535 parts list various cd/m² / mcd ranges — check vendor spec for exact brightness.
Pinout: usually DIN, VDD, GND, DOUT (data in / data out chainable).
Recommended ambient / storage temps: follow the vendor datasheet (typical operating −40°C to +85°C for many parts). Verify manufacturer sheet for exact limits.
Decoupling: place a 100 µF electrolytic (or similar bulk cap) across 5 V and GND near the first LED, plus 0.1 µF bypass caps if possible. This prevents supply dips when many LEDs switch on.
Data line resistor: 220–470 Ω series resistor on the data line (between MCU and DIN) helps reduce ringing and protects the first LED. Many guides recommend it.

Level shifting: if your MCU runs at 3.3 V and LEDs at 5 V, 3.3 V data sometimes works, but a proper level shifter (or a fast MOSFET-based level translator) is recommended for reliability on long runs.

Power distribution: at full white use lots of current — inject 5 V power every ~30–50 LEDs (or according to your layout) to avoid voltage drop and color-shift. Calculate total current: I_total ≈ LEDs × I_per_LED_fullwhite (e.g. 100 LEDs × 60 mA = 6 A).
Frame/refresh rate: ~800 kHz data rate → full-frame update time depends on LED count (e.g. ~37 FPS for ~900 LEDs at 24 bits/LED theoretical). Real-world animation speed varies with controller code.

uge-116807.summary: The 07D391K is a 390V metal oxide varistor designed to protect electronic circuits by clamping and absorbing destructive voltage transients and surge energy.

blocks.text: The 07D391K is a voltage-dependent, nonlinear semiconductor component. Its primary function is to protect sensitive electronic circuits by acting as a high-impedance shunt under normal operating conditions. However, when a transient over-voltage event occurs and exceeds its specific threshold, the varistor instantly switches to a state of very low impedance.

This device is a multilayer structure composed primarily of zinc oxide (ZnO) grains mixed with other metal oxides, forming the bulk of the ceramic element. These grains create a network of semiconductor junctions, which are responsible for the component’s unique current-voltage characteristics. The entire element is encased in a robust, flame-retardant epoxy resin coating, ensuring mechanical integrity and electrical isolation.

The critical action of the 07D391K is to clamp transient voltages to a safe, predetermined level, thereby diverting the potentially damaging surge current away from vulnerable components. By absorbing and dissipating the energy from voltage spikes as heat, it effectively limits the voltage across its terminals to a maximum clamping value, ensuring the downstream circuitry remains within its safe operating voltage range.
Fast response to transient over-voltage events.
Low clamping ratio for effective voltage limitation.
No follow-on current after the surge subsides.

UM66 is a melody generating IC commonly used in calling bell, phone, toys, musical bell in doors, home security alarm systems, burglar alarms etc. It is a three pin IC looks like a transistor. Its first pin is ground, second is VCC and the third is the melody output. Supply voltage that can be given to the IC is in the range of 1.5V- 4.5V. These are CMOS ICs and have very small power consumption. Melody generator will reset when the power is turned on and then the melody begins from the first note.

The melody generator has an inbuilt beat and tone generator. The time base for beat and tone generator is an inbuilt oscillator. Tone generator and beat generator are programmed divider. Tone generator produces certain frequency. These frequencies are a factor of the oscillator frequency. Beat generator contains 15 available beats. Of these four beats can be selected. It has a 62 notes ROM to play music. A set of 4 bits controls the scale code while 2 bits control the rhythm code.

Many versions of UM66 are produced to generate tones of different songs, for eg. UM66T01 generates tone for songs ‘Jingle bells’, ‘Santa Claus is coming to town’ and ‘We wish you a merry X’mas’, UTC UM66T05L for ‘ Home sweet home’, UTC UM66T19L for ‘ For Alice,’ UTC UM66T32L for ‘COO COO waltz’ and UTC UM66T68L ‘It is a small world’.

.The supply input to the IC should not exceed 4.5V. Otherwise it may damage the IC. So if we want to combine this circuit with some other circuit having VCC greater than 4.5V then use zener diode voltage regulator.
The following diagram shows the working of UM66 as a musical IC.

In this zener diode voltage regulator is used. This will maintain the required supply voltage less than 4.5 while combining with other circuits. Here zener diode with a breakdown voltage of 3.3V is used. This will maintain output voltage nearer to 3.3V for a wide range of reverse current. Supply input (pin 2) of the UM66 is given to the regulator output. Melody output is taken from pin3. This output is lower in amplitude and cannot drive a loudspeaker. Thus an NPN transistor is used for amplification. Output of the melody generator is given to the BC547 NPN transistor through 1K resistor for limiting the current. Amplified output is given to the loudspeaker.
Note : You can use a low power speaker like 8Ω, 0.5W.

blocks.text: ATmega328P U-TH AVR Microcontroller TQFP32 is a high-performance, low-power 8-bit AVR RISC-based microcontroller designed for embedded systems, control circuits, DIY electronics, automation projects, and custom PCB designs. It combines a powerful instruction set, reliable non-volatile memory, multiple communication interfaces, timers, interrupts, analog inputs, and flexible power-saving modes inside a compact surface-mount TQFP32 package.

This microcontroller is widely known for its use in Arduino-compatible designs, standalone embedded boards, sensor controllers, robotics circuits, battery-powered projects, and educational electronics applications. The ATmega328P family provides a strong balance between processing capability, low power consumption, easy programming, and excellent availability of development resources.

The device includes 32KB of in-system programmable flash memory with read-while-write capability, 1KB EEPROM, 2KB SRAM, 23 general-purpose input and output lines, 32 general-purpose working registers, three flexible timer/counters, internal and external interrupts, USART serial communication, two-wire serial interface, SPI serial port, analog-to-digital converter channels, watchdog timer, and several selectable power-saving modes.
8-bit AVR RISC architecture: Designed for efficient instruction execution and stable embedded performance.
Low-power picoPower technology: Suitable for portable, battery-powered, and energy-sensitive applications.
32KB ISP flash memory: Supports in-system programming and read-while-write operation.
2KB SRAM and 1KB EEPROM: Provides memory for runtime variables and non-volatile stored settings.
23 general-purpose I/O lines: Flexible pins for digital input, output, communication, and control functions.
Multiple timers and counters: Useful for timing control, PWM generation, frequency measurement, and event handling.
Serial communication support: Includes USART, SPI, and 2-wire serial interface for connecting modules and peripherals.
Analog input support: Includes 10-bit analog-to-digital conversion for sensor reading and measurement circuits.
Programmable watchdog timer: Helps improve system reliability in embedded applications.
Surface-mount TQFP32 package: Suitable for compact PCB layouts and production designs.

The ATmega328P U-TH is commonly used in projects that require Arduino-style development or direct AVR programming. When using this chip with Arduino-based workflows, make sure the exact ATmega328P device is selected in the programming environment, because the P version has a different device signature from some non-P variants. If the chip is blank, a bootloader may need to be burned first using a suitable AVR ISP programmer before uploading code through a USB-to-serial interface.

For custom PCB design, the TQFP32 package is suitable for compact boards but requires proper footprint selection, stable power supply decoupling, reset circuitry, programming header access, and clock configuration depending on the application. The device can operate from 1.8V to 5.5V, making it suitable for both low-voltage and 5V-compatible circuits when designed correctly.

The ATmega328P U-TH AVR Microcontroller TQFP32 is supplied for electronics development, repair, education, and custom circuit design. blocks.text: The 5V-7905 Negative Voltage Regulator is an electronic component designed to provide a stable negative output voltage of -5V, typically used in power supply circuits for electronic systems that require negative voltage. It operates in a wide input voltage range, typically from +12V to +24V DC, and provides a constant negative 5V output for use in various applications.

The name 7905 signifies two meaning, “79” means that it is a negative voltage regulator and “05” means that it provides 5V as output. So our 7905 will provide a -5V output voltage. The output current of this IC can go up to 1.5A, but the IC suffers from heavy heat loss hence a Heat sink is recommended for projects that consume more current. For example if the input voltage is 12V and you are consuming 1A, then (12-5) * 1 = 7W. This 7 Watts will be dissipated as heat.

blocks.text: The Raspberry Pi 4B 4GB is the mid-range memory option in the Raspberry Pi 4 lineup, built around the same Broadcom BCM2711 quad-core Cortex-A72 CPU as the 2GB and 8GB variants. It's one of RAM Electronics' Raspberry Pi boards, striking a practical balance for everyday desktop use, moderate multitasking, and most hobby or classroom projects.
Broadcom BCM2711, Quad-core Cortex-A72 (ARM v8) 64-bit SoC @ 1.5GHz

4-pole stereo audio and composite video port

Power over Ethernet (PoE) enabled (requires separate PoE HAT)
A practical middle ground — enough RAM for a real desktop experience with several browser tabs or applications open, without paying for headroom most hobby projects won't use.
Same CPU, I/O, and GPIO layout as the 2GB and 8GB variants, so it's a drop-in fit for tutorials and projects written for any Raspberry Pi 4 board.
Comfortable for running a handful of background services at once — a home server plus a couple of lightweight apps, for example.

Need to go lighter on budget? The Raspberry Pi 4B 2GB covers single-purpose projects for less. Need more headroom for heavier multitasking? The Raspberry Pi 4B 8GB or the newer-generation Raspberry Pi 5 4GB step up further.
Common Uses for the Raspberry Pi 4B 4GB
Everyday desktop computing — browsing, office documents, and light development work.
Home server projects: file sharing, media streaming (Plex/Jellyfin-style setups), or a personal cloud.
Moderate home automation hubs running several integrations at once.
General-purpose development boards for programming, IoT prototyping, and electronics coursework.
Small business or classroom fleets where a bit more headroom than the 2GB model is worth the cost difference.
Is the Raspberry Pi 4B 4GB enough for everyday desktop use?

Yes — 4GB is comfortable for typical desktop tasks like web browsing with multiple tabs, office documents, and light development work. Heavier workloads (multiple VMs, memory-intensive applications) are better suited to the 8GB variant.
What's the difference between the 4GB board and the 2GB or 8GB models?

All three use the identical Broadcom BCM2711 Cortex-A72 CPU, the same ports, and the same GPIO layout — only the RAM amount changes, affecting how much you can run at once rather than raw processing speed.
Can I run a home server on the 4GB model?
Yes — 4GB comfortably handles common home-server tasks like file sharing, media streaming, or a small personal cloud setup, especially when running just one or two services at a time.
Is 4GB the best balance for most projects?

For the large majority of hobby, classroom, and general home-server projects, 4GB is the commonly recommended starting point — enough headroom for real use without paying for capacity most projects won't need.

Looking for a practical, well-balanced Raspberry Pi 4 board? Shop the Raspberry Pi 4B 4GB at RAM Electronics — a comfortable fit for everyday desktop use, home servers, and general projects, with room to step up to 8GB or Raspberry Pi 5 later if needed.

This dual-output functionality, combined with its compatibility with microcontrollers like Arduino and Raspberry Pi, makes the KY-024 ideal for applications ranging from simple magnetic switches to complex position and speed sensing systems.

makers-446704.summary: The Encoder Wheel 20 Slots is a rotating disk with 20 slots, used to generate pulses for tracking rotation, speed, and position in robotics and motion system.

blocks.text: The Encoder Wheel – 20 Slots is a simple yet effective mechanical component used to detect rotational motion in motors and wheels. It consists of a circular disk with 20 evenly spaced slots or cutouts, designed to work with an optical or infrared sensor. As the wheel rotates, these slots pass between a light source and a detector, allowing light to intermittently reach the sensor. Each time a slot passes through the sensor’s detection area, it generates a digital pulse. With 20 slots, the wheel provides 20 pulses per full rotation, making it suitable for low-resolution motion tracking and rotational feedback.

This encoder wheel is often made from lightweight materials like plastic or acrylic, ensuring it doesn’t add significant load to the motor shaft. It typically has a central hole that allows it to be mounted directly onto a motor shaft, making it a convenient choice for robotic and automation projects. The spacing and precision of the slots are critical in determining the accuracy of the encoder system.

The Encoder Wheel – 20 Slots is widely used in DIY electronics, robotics, educational projects, and entry-level automation systems. It’s ideal for applications such as measuring wheel rotation, calculating distance traveled, or monitoring the speed of a DC motor. When combined with a microcontroller like Arduino or Raspberry Pi, it can be used to build simple yet functional closed-loop control systems.

Although it provides a relatively low resolution compared to high-slot encoder wheels, it is perfect for basic feedback systems where high precision isn’t essential. It offers a balance of simplicity, affordability, and practical functionality, making it an excellent tool for students, hobbyists, and makers exploring motion detection and control.

blocks.text: Where to use the RC522 RFID Module

The RC522 is an RF Module that consists of an RFID reader, an RFID card, and a key chain. The module operates 13.56MHz which is an industrial (ISM) band and hence can be used without any license problem. The module operates at 3.3V typically and hence commonly used in 3.3V designs. It is normally used in applications where a certain person/object has to be identified with a unique ID.

The keychain has 1kB memory in it which can be used to store unique data. The RC522 reader module can both read and write data into these memory elements. The reader can read data only from passive tags that operate on 13.56MHz.
How to use the RC522 RFID Module

The RC522 has an operating voltage between 2.5V to 3.3V and hence is normally powered by 3.3V and should be used with 3.3V communication lines. However, the communication pins of this module are 5V tolerant and hence it can be used with 5V microcontrollers also like Arduino without any additional hardware. The module supports SPI, IIC, and UART communication but out of these SPI is often used since it is fasted with a maximum data rate of 10Mbps.

Since in application, most of the time reader module will be waiting for the tag to come into proximity. The Reader can be put into power-down mode to save power in battery-operated applications. This can be achieved by using the IRQ pin on the module. The minimum current consumed by the module during power-down mode will be 10uA only. The module can be easily used with Arduino because of its readily available RC522 RFID Arduino library from Miguel Balboa. You can visit his GitHub page for more details on how to use it with Arduino.

blocks.text: The CD4052BE Dual 4-Channel Analog Multiplexer/Demultiplexer DIP-16 is a CMOS analog switching IC designed to control analog or digital signal routing using digital address inputs. It contains two independent 4-channel sections, commonly identified as X and Y channels, allowing paired signal paths to be selected at the same time. This makes it suitable for differential or dual-signal switching applications where two related signals need to be routed together. The device is supplied in a 16-pin PDIP package, making it practical for breadboards, prototyping, repair work, and through-hole PCB designs.

According to the datasheet, the CD4052B uses two binary control inputs, A and B, together with an inhibit input. These control signals select one of four channel pairs and connect the selected analog inputs to the common outputs. When the inhibit input is set to logic high, all channels are turned off, allowing the circuit to disconnect all signal paths when needed. The IC also includes logic-level conversion, enabling digital control signals to switch analog signals over a wider signal range.

The CD4052BE is useful in circuits that require compact, low-power signal selection, such as data acquisition, audio signal routing, sensor channel selection, and analog-to-digital or digital-to-analog conversion systems. It offers low quiescent power dissipation, low ON resistance, and very low OFF leakage, helping maintain signal integrity while reducing power consumption. Its break-before-make switching operation helps prevent channel overlap during transitions, making it reliable for precision switching and multiplexing applications.

How to select a Zener Diode

A Zener diode is one of the different types of diodes, but is used for entirely different purpose than the common rectifier diodes. They are mainly used in protection circuits or as crude voltage regulators. Let us see how we can select one for your application.

There are two main parameters that are to be checked while selecting a Zener diode for your electronic design. One is the Zener Voltage and the other is Power dissipation. The Zener voltage is the voltage which appears across the Zener diode when a higher reverse potential voltage is applied to it. In regulator circuits it is this voltage (Zener voltage) which will be regulated and in protection circuit it is this voltage (Zener voltage) more than which the circuit is protected. The power dissipation decides the amount of current that can flow through the diode. Higher the power dissipation higher the current can flow.
How to use a Zener Diode

As said a Zener diode will mostly be used in a protection circuit or in a crude voltage regulator circuit. Either way, it very important to remember that a Zener diode should always be used along with a Zener resistor.

A Zener resistor is nothing but an ordinary resistor which is used for current limiting purpose. This resistor decides (limits) the amount of current that can flow through the Zener diode or through the load connected to Zener diode; this was the Zener diode is protected from high current. Transformer 220Vac to 9-0-9Vac (1A) is a high-quality electronic component designed for Arduino, prototyping, and educational electronics. 9-0-9 1A Center Tapped Step Down Transformer is a general-purpose chassis mounting mains transformer. The transformer has 230V primary winding and center-tapped secondary winding. The transformer has flying-colored insulated connecting leads ( Approx 20 cm long ). The Transformer acts as a step-down transformer reducing AC – 220V to AC – 9V.
The Transformer gives outputs of 9V, 9V, and 0V. The Transformer’s construction is written below with details of Solid Core and Winding.

The transformer is a static electrical device that transfers energy by inductive coupling between its winding circuits. A varying current in the primary winding creates a varying magnetic flux in the transformer’s core and thus a varying magnetic flux through the secondary winding. This varying magnetic flux induces a varying electromotive force (E.M.F) or voltage in the secondary winding. The transformer has cores made of high-permeability silicon steel. The steel has a permeability many times that of free space and the core thus serves to greatly reduce the magnetizing current and confine the flux to a path that closely couples the winding.

باور بانك هيريجو دي بي كيه اتش ار ٠٠٥ هو شاحن متنقل بسيط وعملي بسعة ١٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير، مناسب للاستخدام اليومي وشحن الموبايل والإكسسوارات الصغيرة أثناء التنقل. المنتج مصمم ليكون حل اقتصادي وسهل الاستخدام لمن يحتاج مصدر طاقة احتياطي في الشغل أو الدراسة أو السفر أو الطوارئ، مع خرج شحن إجمالي حتى ١٠ وات ومؤشرات ضوئية لمعرفة مستوى البطارية.

هذا الموديل يعتمد على فكرة الاستخدام العملي بدون تعقيد. لا يحتوي على كابلات مدمجة، لذلك يمكن استخدامه مع كابل الشحن المناسب لكل جهاز. يحتوي الباور بانك على مخرجي شحن عاديين، مما يسمح بتوصيل جهازين متوافقين في نفس الوقت ضمن حدود الخرج الإجمالي المدعوم. كما يحتوي على مدخلين لإعادة شحن الباور بانك، مدخل تايب سي ومدخل ميكرو، وكلاهما يعمل بقيمة ٥ فولت ٢ أمبير طبقًا للبيانات الموجودة على العبوة.

يأتي المنتج بتصميم أبيض نحيف وسهل الحمل، مع مؤشرات ضوئية صغيرة توضح مستوى البطارية المتبقي. الصور المرفقة توضح أن المنتج مناسب لشحن الموبايلات وبعض أجهزة التابلت والسماعات اللاسلكية والأجهزة الصغيرة المتوافقة. عدد مرات الشحن الفعلي يختلف حسب سعة بطارية الجهاز وحالة البطارية وجودة الكابل والاستخدام أثناء الشحن وفقد الطاقة الطبيعي أثناء التحويل.

بطارية ١٤٥٠٠ قابلة للشحن ٣٫٧ فولت ١٨٠٠ مللي أمبير مع فيشة سوداء وكابل شحن يو إس بي هي مجموعة عملية مكونة من بطارية ليثيوم قابلة للشحن وكابل شحن مناسب، وتستخدم في الألعاب التي تعمل بالريموت، والعربيات الصغيرة، والطائرات الصغيرة، ومشروعات الإلكترونيات، والدوائر المحمولة منخفضة الجهد.

البطارية تأتي بسلكين وفيشة سوداء جاهزة للتوصيل، مما يسهل تركيبها في الأجهزة المتوافقة بدون لحام مباشر على أطراف البطارية. كما يأتي معها كابل شحن يو إس بي مناسب لشحن البطارية من مصدر طاقة يو إس بي مناسب مثل شاحن موبايل، باور بنك، أو منفذ حاسب، مع الالتزام بملاحظات الأمان أثناء الشحن والاستخدام.

A non-contact voltage tester is the safest way to make sure the power is off without touching any wires. Non-contact voltage testers work by detecting the changing electric field around objects conducting an AC current (AC stands for “alternating current”).
Before you open an electrical box, you should cut off power to the outlet at the main electrical panel and confirm that you turned off the right circuit.

This is where the non-contact voltage tester comes in handy. The tester will light up and/or make noise when it comes close to a hot (live) wire, even one that’s covered in plastic insulation. Note that it can’t test through metal conduit or metal sheathing.

Non-contact voltage testers (also known as voltage tester pens, test pens, or voltage sensors) are the safest way to detect the presence of AC voltage and ideal for testing power cables, circuit breakers, wall outlets, junction boxes, and fuses.
Method of Use: Non-contact electric pen

blocks.text: These are replacement soldering iron tips in the widely-used 900M series, a standard tip form-factor compatible with a large range of soldering irons and stations built around the same tip mount – meaning these aren’t limited to one specific iron brand. Over time, a soldering tip’s working surface oxidizes and wears from repeated heat cycling and solder contact, which is why having spare tips on hand keeps a soldering station usable long after the original tip has degraded, rather than needing to replace the whole iron.

This pack includes 3 tips, giving enough spares to keep working through normal tip wear or to keep a couple of different tip conditions on hand (a well-tinned tip for fine work, a spare in reserve) without needing to reorder right after wear sets in on the first one.

blocks.text: MT6701 Magnetic Angle Sensor Module is a contactless rotary position sensor (magnetic encoder) that measures absolute angle from 0° to 360°. It uses a rotating diametrically magnetized magnet placed above the chip to detect angle with high resolution. Compared with common Hall encoders, it can provide absolute angle, incremental ABZ quadrature, and PWM/analog outputs (depending on the module breakout and configuration), making it a strong alternative to AS5600 for robotics, motor control, knobs, and automation.

This is a force sensitive resistor with a round, 12.7mm diameter, sensing area. This FSR will vary its resistance depending on how much pressure is being applied to the sensing area. The harder the force, the lower the resistance. When no pressure is being applied to the FSR its resistance will be larger than 1MΩ. This FSR can sense applied force anywhere in the range of 100g-10kg.
Two pins extend from the bottom of the sensor with 0.1″ pitch making it bread board friendly. There is a peel-and-stick rubber backing on the other side of the sensing area to mount the FSR.
These sensors are simple to set up and great for sensing pressure, but they aren’t incredibly accurate. Use them to sense if it’s being squeezed, but you may not want to use it as a scale.
